The adversarial judge validated the switch hypothesis (H1) and invalidated the three others: software defect (no exceptions, not deterministic), process failure (one clean start, stable memory), and load saturation (13 requests in total — almost no demand).

**One open gap:** the telemetry shows one `POST /chaos/enable`, but it carries no caller identity. The mechanism is proven; the actor is not. Verdict: `infra-process` / `degradation-switch`. Trigger latency was 10 seconds; the investigation took 368 seconds.
